Files That Remember

NIO one-liners, auto-closing registers, kindness for missing files.

⏱ 18 min🧠 No experience needed🧪 Interactive
Step 1

Register, read, auto-return

Never walk off holding it.

📖

Library desk. Open the register (Path), write/read lines, AUTO-RETURN via try-with-resources — even mid-fire. Missing file? Weather, not bug: defaults + message.

Round trip
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.io.IOException;
try {
  Files.writeString(Path.of("hi.txt"), "Hello file!");
  String back = Files.readString(Path.of("hi.txt"));
  System.out.println(back); // "Hello file!"
} catch (IOException e) {
  System.out.println("File trouble: " + e.getMessage());
}
writeString creates + truncates + closes solo. Relative hi.txt resolves at the RUN folder — print user.dir when lost.
